items.definition:
the state of being or going beyond the limits of ordinary experience
Many spiritual traditions seek to achieve a state of transcendence.

a man who held land by military service, ranking between an ordinary freeman and a hereditary noble
Macbeth was the Thane of Cawdor.

a plant, especially a herbaceous one; the liquid extracted from the malt in the brewing process
The brewer added hops to the wort before fermentation.

A waxy, translucent, starch-like protein that is deposited in tissues in certain diseases.
Abnormal amyloid deposits are a hallmark of Alzheimer's disease.

the genetic constitution of an individual organism
The genotype determines the observable characteristics of an organism.

a type of alcohol, often used as antifreeze
Ethylene glycol is a common ingredient in antifreeze.

cruel and bitter criticism
The politician's speech was full of vitriol against his opponents.

a Scottish town or borough
Edinburgh is a historic burgh with a rich past.

the chemical breakdown of a compound due to reaction with water
The enzyme catalyzes the hydrolysis of starch.

a nonessential amino acid
Tyrosine is an important amino acid in the human body.

the action of inserting something of a different nature into something else
The data analysis involved interpolation to estimate missing values.

The tube that carries urine from the bladder.
The doctor explained the function of the urethra.

A soft, gentle breeze.
A gentle zephyr rustled the leaves.

the obstruction of the blood supply to an organ or region of tissue, causing local tissue death
A myocardial infarction is commonly known as a heart attack.

a former French coin of small value; a small amount of money
He didn't have a sou to his name after losing everything.

a device that converts energy from one form to another
The microphone acts as a transducer, converting sound waves into electrical signals.

a kiss
He gave his child a loving buss on the forehead.

a foolish or incompetent person (offensive slang)
Don't be such a dipshit and pay attention!

a type of white blood cell that is part of the immune system
Lymphocytes play a crucial role in the body's defense against disease.

a disease or dysfunction of one or more peripheral nerves
Diabetic neuropathy can cause numbness and pain in the feet.

a chemical substance that transmits nerve impulses across a synapse
Serotonin is an important neurotransmitter that affects mood.

The science of collecting and analyzing complex biological data.
Bioinformatics plays a crucial role in modern genetic research.

a comprehensive treatise or summary
He wrote a summa of his philosophical ideas.

The manner of development of a disease
Understanding the pathogenesis of the virus is crucial for developing effective treatments.

A radioactive isotope of carbon, especially carbon-14
Scientists use radiocarbon dating to determine the age of ancient artifacts.

a piece of armor for the shin
The knight wore greaves to protect his legs.

the abnormal narrowing of a passage in the body
Spinal stenosis can cause pain and numbness.

something or someone that one vehemently dislikes; a formal curse
The idea of war was anathema to him.

positively charged ion
A cation is an ion with a net positive charge.

complex of DNA and proteins in cells
Chromatin condenses to form chromosomes during cell division.

a protein that acts as a messenger between cells
Cytokines play a crucial role in the immune response.

neoliberalism (a political approach that favors free-market capitalism)
Critics argue that neoliberalism has led to increased economic inequality.

oeuvre (the complete work of an artist, composer, or writer)
The exhibition showcased the entire oeuvre of the renowned painter.

ordinator (one who ordains or coordinates; often in a religious or technical context)
The ordinator was responsible for overseeing the complex project schedule.

the surgical removal of part of an organ or structure
The patient underwent a bowel resection.

a disease of the arteries characterized by the deposition of fatty material on their inner walls
Atherosclerosis can lead to heart attacks and strokes.

the removal of the testicles
Veterinarians often perform castration on male animals.

a fatal epidemic disease.
The city was ravaged by a terrible pestilence.

a space or chamber in which air or other gas is at a pressure greater than that of the outside atmosphere; also, a meeting attended by all members of a committee or conference.
The air conditioning system uses a plenum to distribute air.

a male sex hormone
Androgen levels can affect various bodily functions in men.

the defining spirit or mood of a particular period of history as shown by the ideas and beliefs of the time.
The film perfectly captured the zeitgeist of the 1960s.

the act or process of adjudicating a dispute.
The dispute is currently awaiting adjudication.

a type of subatomic particle
The Higgs boson is sometimes called the 'God particle'.

a defensive wall or protection
The old castle walls served as a bulwark against invaders.

the branch of physiology and medicine concerned with endocrine glands and hormones
She decided to specialize in endocrinology.

the quality or state of being diverse in character or content
The study examined the heterogeneity of the patient population.

Treatment that uses the body's immune system
Immunotherapy is a promising new cancer treatment.

The action of intervening on behalf of another
He sought divine intercession for his ailing mother.

A protein that inhibits virus replication
Interferon is used in the treatment of some viral infections.

a set of beliefs or assumptions about something
The film explores the mythos surrounding the ancient hero.

the purity or intensity of color
The artist adjusted the chroma to make the colors more vibrant.

a dull, heavy sound, especially of an explosion
They heard the distant crump of artillery.

a coefficient or constant that expresses a particular property of a substance or system
In physics, the Young's modulus measures the stiffness of a material.

a malignant tumor of the bone marrow
Multiple myeloma is a type of cancer.

blockage; the meeting of teeth
The dental occlusion was perfect after the braces.

a friend (often used in legal contexts, e.g., amicus curiae)
The court allowed an amicus brief to be filed by the non-profit organization.

any of a group of compounds consisting of a hemoprotein and functioning as electron transfer agents in metabolic pathways
Cytochrome P450 enzymes play a crucial role in drug metabolism.

a chemical element (Mo)
Molybdenum is a silvery-white metal used in alloys.

a major estrogen hormone
Estradiol plays a key role in the female reproductive system and bone health.

a contrapuntal musical composition or a state of amnesia
The composer's latest work included a complex fugue.

philosophical study of experience and consciousness
His research focused on the phenomenology of perception.

the study of language in historical context
She pursued a degree in classical philology.

a condition in which tissue similar to the lining of the uterus grows outside the uterus
Endometriosis can cause severe pelvic pain.

similarity in structure or function due to common ancestry
The homology between human and ape skeletons is striking.
